mechanism: Benazepril may increase mefloquine levels through potential CYP3A4 inhibition and ACE inhibitor-mediated reduction in renal clearance, while mefloquine can cause cardiac arrhythmias that may be potentiated by benazepril's effects on electrolytes.
action: Monitor for mefloquine toxicity signs (neuropsychiatric symptoms, cardiac effects); ensure adequate renal function; consider alternative antimalarial if possible; baseline and periodic ECG monitoring recommended.
